summary_md: **AI Druid Cat ([@AiDruidCat](https://x.com/AiDruidCat/status/2115707710540857410))** presents **Kitty Open Studio**, an open-source AI video studio on top of ComfyUI with open-weight models, local GPU execution, a real timeline editor, and Claude or ChatGPT directing it over MCP, entered in the Open Source Higgsfield challenge ([DruidCat237/kitty-open-studio](https://github.com/DruidCat237/kitty-open-studio)).
